Date of final diagnosis as parsed
Days from case date to diagnosis date
Calendar fields of the case date (season: southern hemisphere); weekday is derived from the parsed case date
Recorded designation: heat cramps, body cramps, heat stroke, unclassified
A or B (anonymised)
Level number as recorded (nominal depth below collar; not comparable across shafts)
Coded raise line and section (crosswalks held by the mine)
Permanent or contractor as recorded
Day, Night or not recorded
Occupation group (keyword mapping in the Methodology); True where the raw label was the generic "mining team"
Age in years as recorded
Wet-bulb C, dry-bulb C and air velocity m/s at the case-linked reading, as recorded
Velocity review class (copied-value logic failure; extreme high-value review; high-value review), blank if none
All three readings recorded; quality-valid (triplet and no review flag)
Recorded personal and worker-context fields as classified in the Methods
For the alcohol class: explicit timing within 48 h, or affirmed without timing (bare yes/possible)
Months since last heat-tolerance screening and precision of the screening date
Presence and length of the text fields (the text itself is not included)
